content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: When observations have a time order, random splitting or calculations that use future rows can leak information into the past. Keep timestamps aligned, use shifts intentionally, and validate the split boundary.

import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"date": pd.date_range("2026-01-01", periods=4), "value": [2, 3, 4, 5]})
df["previous_value"] = df["value"].shift(1)
print(df["previous_value"].isna().sum())
